title: Super-intelligence or Superstition? Exploring Psychological Factors Influencing Belief in AI Predictions about Personal Behavior
summary: This paper explores the psychological factors that influence people's belief in AI predictions about their personal behavior, questioning whether such beliefs are based on actual super-intelligence or are a form of superstition. It likely examines cognitive biases, trust in technology, and other psychological mechanisms.
highlights: Investigates psychological factors behind belief in AI predictions
Challenges the notion of AI super-intelligence in personal behavior prediction
Connects AI trust to cognitive biases and superstition
